title: Streamliner Performance and Robustness
summary: Formed from the seeded candidate. Wave 1 measures realistic multi-tab usage and adds missing diagnostics before optimization nodes are promoted.

nodes.title: Performance baseline and bottleneck map
nodes.summary: Reproduce realistic multi-tab Streamliner usage, measure request volume, endpoint latency, EventSource behavior, background cadence, graph/source loading, and file-store IO, then export a baseline report and quick-win priority list.

nodes.title: Diagnostics instrumentation foundation
nodes.summary: Add the low-overhead durable diagnostics the baseline proves are missing so slow endpoints, request fanout, background scans, graph/source loads, and store work are visible during later optimization.

nodes.title: Baseline findings gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates that the load shape, bottleneck map, diagnostics gaps, and quick-win priority order match real Streamliner usage before optimization work proceeds.

nodes.title: Client and API request fanout reduction
nodes.summary: Reduce duplicate browser/API work according to the accepted bottleneck map: polling, focus refresh, EventSource-triggered refetches, graph/workstream reloads, stable-data caching, and safe cross-tab coordination where warranted.

nodes.title: Background and store efficiency
nodes.summary: Tune the highest-impact server/background/store paths from the accepted baseline, including session registry refreshes, launch-claim scans, workstream-source scanning, graph loads, context/activity/PAW indexing, and file-store reads/writes.

nodes.title: Optimization impact gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates that the targeted fanout and background/store changes materially improve responsiveness under the accepted multi-tab load shape without changing intended semantics.

nodes.title: Robustness diagnostics and regression coverage
nodes.summary: Codify the accepted many-tab robustness expectations through durable diagnostics, regression tests or manual load-test recipes, operator documentation, and guardrails for future graph/session/workstream surfaces.

nodes.title: Performance robustness closure gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates the final performance baseline comparison, diagnostics/export package, and downstream guidance before the workstream closes or spins out follow-on storage/architecture work.

checkpoints.title: Baseline and diagnostics ready
checkpoints.summary: Realistic multi-tab usage has been measured, diagnostics gaps have been closed enough for optimization, and the builder has accepted the bottleneck map.

checkpoints.title: Top bottlenecks addressed
checkpoints.summary: The highest-impact client/API fanout and background/store bottlenecks from the accepted baseline have been addressed and validated under the same load shape.

checkpoints.title: Robustness export ready
checkpoints.summary: Diagnostics, regression coverage, load-test guidance, and downstream performance expectations are ready for future workstreams to consume.
